description: Shows pull-request state, CI attention and follow-up progress on sidebar rows, so you see what needs you without opening a thread. One glyph tracks what the pull request is — open, draft, merged or closed — and a second tracks whether it wants something from you: checks running or failed, merge conflicts, changes requested, a review, or a block on merging. A ring shows how much of a thread's follow-up list is closed. Badges draw on whichever sidebar you use — at most two per row by default, with a priority you set deciding which win the slots — and bb owns the git-host lookup and the polling, so running both pull-request badges costs no extra requests. The ring needs the Follow Up plugin; without it the ring does not draw and the other badges are unaffected.
